description: This file defines the interface and data structures related to 'tree' objects in a version control system, including functions for parsing, comparing, reading, and managing tree objects.

methods.name: lookup_tree
methods.description: Locates and returns a tree object in a repository given its object ID.

methods.name: parse_tree_buffer
methods.description: Parses a buffer into a tree object structure.

methods.name: parse_tree_gently
methods.description: Parses a tree object, optionally quiet on missing trees.

methods.name: int parse_tree(struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Inline function that parses a tree with standard options.

methods.name: free_tree_buffer
methods.description: Frees the buffer associated with a tree object.

methods.name: parse_tree_indirect
methods.description: Parses and returns a tree object indirectly via its object ID.

methods.name: base_name_compare
methods.description: Compares base names of two path entries.

methods.name: df_name_compare
methods.description: Performs a filename comparison with a diff context.

methods.name: read_tree_at
methods.description: Recursively reads a tree at a specific depth and location.

methods.name: read_tree
methods.description: Reads a tree object with a specified pathspec.

ctags.name: read_tree_fn_t
ctags.pattern: /^typedef int (*read_tree_fn_t)(const struct object_id *, struct strbuf *, const char *, unsigned /
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(const struct object_id *,struct strbuf *,const char *,unsigned int,void *)
